description: Header file defining the MojoAudioEncoder class, which implements media::AudioEncoder and mojom::AudioEncoderClient for proxying audio encoding via Mojo IPC in Chromium.

classes.name: MojoAudioEncoder
classes.description: A class that proxies media::AudioEncoder calls to a Mojo remote, handling IPC communication and callbacks.

methods.name: MojoAudioEncoder
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the MojoAudioEncoder with a pending remote.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the encoder with options, output callback, and done callback.

methods.name: Encode
methods.description: Encodes audio data with a capture timestamp.

methods.name: OnEncodedBufferReady
methods.description: Callback when an encoded buffer is ready.
